Added item to BACKLOG.md section 504.
Item: S504-11 (founder real-time 2026-09-19): fix HUD font glyph gaps — packages/common/hud_text.h (vendored PAPERCRAFT stroke font) lacks < > [ ] = ' so phone UI/text renders them as blobs; worked around in draw_bigo_phone with * ( ) - +, but any text using those chars is broken. Add the missing glyphs (or replace with a real font path); also lowercase folds to caps only.

⚓ ☃
